concerns.location: plan.md:Section 6 – Attribution on Failure / Success Cases
concerns.text: SC‑004 requires that the absolute difference in global‑context activation proportion between failure and success groups be **≥ 30 %**, but the plan only computes and reports the difference without any check or statistical test to verify that this threshold is met. This leaves the success criterion unvalidated and the analysis unable to confirm whether the claim holds.
